title: Distinct chlorophyll hotspots
query:
Determine whether the 2011 northern South China Sea shelf contains distinct chlorophyll hotspots associated with river-influenced and upwelling-influenced waters. Quantify their differences and assess whether the available evidence supports different nutrient-supply pathways.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
